title: B · composed coverage judge  [ann1]
label_config:
<View style="max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">
  <View style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#7a56d6;margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_h" value="Assistant response — score atomic-fact coverage"/></View>
  <View style="background:#f2eefc;border-left:4px solid #7a56d6;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;line-height:1.5;"><Text name="response" value="$response"/></View>
  <View style="background:#fafafb;border:1px solid #ececf0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:14px;">
    <View style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;row-gap:8px;column-gap:12px;">
      <View style="color:#82889a;font-size:13px;"><Text name="_lq" value="Query"/></View><View><Text name="query" value="$query"/></View>
    </View>
    <View style="color:#c2c6cf;font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;"><Text name="item_id" value="$item_id"/></View>
  </View>

  <View style="background:#fff6e6;border-left:4px solid #e6a817;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#8a6a1d;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_l1" value="Atomic fact 1"/></View>
    <View style="line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="fact1" value="$fact1"/></View>
    <Choices name="covered1" toName="response" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Covered" hint="Explicitly or by clear semantic equivalence (paraphrase OK; substance present)"/>
      <Choice value="Not covered" hint="Missing, or only an implicit/vague mention a reader couldn't extract"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="background:#fff6e6;border-left:4px solid #e6a817;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="color:#8a6a1d;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:4px;"><Text name="_l2" value="Atomic fact 2"/></View>
    <View style="line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="fact2" value="$fact2"/></View>
    <Choices name="covered2" toName="response" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="Covered" hint="Explicitly or by clear semantic equivalence (paraphrase OK; substance present)"/>
      <Choice value="Not covered" hint="Missing, or only an implicit/vague mention a reader couldn't extract"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>

  <View style="padding:12px 14px;margin-top:10px;"><View style="color:#82889a;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_c" value="Optional comment"/></View>
    <TextArea name="comment" toName="response" rows="2" maxSubmissions="1" placeholder="optional"/></View>
</View>
